newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cedenco sees return to profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Cedenco sees return to profit in 1997.

text.p: Cedenco Foods Ltd said on Friday it expected to return to profit in financial 1997 after reporting a net loss of NZ$6.11 million for the year to September 30.
"Cedenco expects a return to profitability from its restructured New Zealand operations and the impact of earnings from Cedenco Australia in the 1997 financial year," the company said.
In its first season, Cedenco Australia expects to process 100,000 tonnes of fruit from planting of 1,580 hectares.
The company said the first crop was maturing well in favourable growing conditions and would come on stream for harvesting and processing late January 1997.

Cedenco's New Zealand operations based in Gisborne were progressing well this season. Cedenco is exporting vegetable powders, mainly sweetcorn powder to Japan, and its nursery operation is producing fresh capsicums also for export to Japan.
The company was continuing to look at expansion and diversification opportunities for its Gisborne based operations.
